lead_with.title: Natixis is already in Montreal: grow it
lead_with.text: Natixis CIB opened a Toronto office in **Oct 2023**, working alongside its **existing Montreal office**, both led by a senior country manager for Canada. Finance Montréal can help **scale the Montreal side** (support, operations, coverage), with Quebec's **IFC tax credit**: **24% of eligible salaries, up to C$18,000 per employee per year** (minimum **6 eligible employees**).

lead_with.title: Cost case vs New York
lead_with.text: A Finance Montréal-commissioned **2026 cost study** puts a 150-person financial operation at about **US$18.9M a year in Montreal vs US$35.3M in New York**, in the **same time zone** and with a **bilingual (French/English)** workforce: a natural fit for a French bank with a large Americas platform.

lead_with.title: Referral partnership for his clients
lead_with.text: As M&A head for **Southeast Asia and India**, Abbas sees clients looking at **North American targets or expansion**. Finance Montréal can offer them a free **landing service in Montreal** (introductions, cost data, incentives): useful value-add for his advisory work, at no cost to him.

person.name: Abbas A. Rangwala
person.text: **Managing Director, Head of M&A, Southeast Asia & India** at Natixis CIB, based in **Singapore**; appointed to this **newly created role in Sep 2023**. Per the appointment release, he reports to the **Head of M&A Asia Pacific** and to the **Head of Real Assets & Investment Banking, Southeast Asia**. **20+ years** in corporate finance, strategy, business development and change management. Before Natixis: **Group Head of M&A and Business Development at Bharti Enterprises** (Indian conglomerate), **Head of M&A at InterGlobe Enterprises**, and senior investment banking roles at **Citigroup** and **Deutsche Bank** in Singapore, Hong Kong and Mumbai. Education: **to be confirmed**. He answered Steve quickly and moved to email: a sign of genuine but formal interest.

company.text: Natixis CIB is Groupe BPCE's corporate and investment bank, serving **corporates, financial institutions, financial sponsors and sovereign/supranational clients** with advisory/M&A, investment banking, financing, global markets and transaction banking. In **Canada**, Natixis CIB has a **Montreal office** and opened a **Toronto office (181 Bay Street, Brookfield Place) in Oct 2023**; both are led by **Michael Costakos, Senior Country Manager for Canada**, under the **Americas CEO (Olivier Delay at the time)**. Current Canadian headcount: **to be confirmed**. Note: the asset-management side (Natixis Investment Managers) sold its Canadian operations to **Fiera Capital in 2019** and sold its remaining Fiera stake in **2022**; current Natixis IM Canada distribution: **to be confirmed**. In Asia, Natixis keeps building M&A: in **Oct 2026** it agreed to buy Tokyo adviser **Sangyo Sosei Advisory** to enter Japanese M&A advisory (subject to regulatory approval).

financials.country: France, Groupe BPCE (cooperative group; Natixis is wholly owned)
financials.text: **Groupe BPCE FY2025:** record net income **€4.1bn (+15%)**, net banking income **€25.7bn (+10%)**, CET1 **16.5%**, c. **35M clients**. **Natixis CIB FY2025:** record revenue **€4.8bn (+10%** at constant FX); Global Markets **+15%**; Investment Banking & M&A **+3%**. **Groupe BPCE H1 2026:** net banking income **€13,919M (+10%)**, net income **€2,357M (+30%)**, CET1 **15.5%** (after the **novobanco** acquisition), underlying cost/income **62.9%**. **CIB H1 2026:** revenue **€2,560M (+5%; +7% constant FX)**, income before tax **€883M (+7%)**; Global Markets c. **€1.5bn**, Global Banking c. **€1.1bn**. In Q2 2026, **Americas** platform revenue rose **19%** and Asia-Pacific/Middle East **7%**. 9M 2026 results: **to be confirmed** (not yet published at time of writing).

industry.title: Asian corporates buying abroad
industry.text: Indian and Southeast Asian groups keep pursuing cross-border acquisitions; North America is a key destination. Banks like Natixis are adding M&A capacity in Asia (Japan deal, Oct 2026).

industry.title: European banks growing in the Americas
industry.text: Natixis CIB's Americas platform grew revenue **19%** in Q2 2026. Growth there raises the question of where to add support and coverage staff at a sensible cost.

industry.title: Cost and near-shore hubs
industry.text: Banks keep moving operations, risk and support roles to lower-cost centres. Montreal offers **New York hours**, French language and the **IFC credit**, at about half the New York cost.

talking_points: Congratulate him on Natixis's **Asian M&A push** (e.g., the Japan advisory acquisition) and ask how the Southeast Asia/India franchise is growing.
Do his **Indian or Southeast Asian clients** look at **North American acquisitions or expansion**? Would a **Montreal landing package** (introductions, cost model, incentives) help him advise them?
Is he aware of Natixis CIB's **Montreal office**? Who decides on **growing it** (Americas CEO, Canada country manager, COO)? Can he **introduce Finance Montréal** to them?
Offer an **IFC-credit cost model** for a sample Natixis team in Montreal, and a visit to meet French peers already there (BNP Paribas, Société Générale, Crédit Agricole).
Propose a simple **referral loop**: Finance Montréal sends him Quebec companies looking at Asia; he flags Asian clients looking at Canada.
